question: What was the name of the principal minister in the Maratha kingdom?
solution: The correct answer is __**Peshwa**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The **Peshwa** was the **principal minister** and the chief executive authority in the **Maratha Empire**. This title became prominent during the reign of the Marathas. • The **Peshwa** initially served as a subordinate to the Chhatrapati (king), but over time, they became the de facto rulers, especially during the 18th century. • The first Peshwa was **Moropant Trimbak Pingle**, appointed by Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, the founder of the Maratha Empire, in **1674**. • The **Peshwas** played a pivotal role in expanding the Maratha Empire across India. They handled both administrative and military affairs and were instrumental in uniting various Maratha factions. • The most notable Peshwa was **Baji Rao I**, known for his military genius and administrative skills. He expanded the Maratha Empire significantly during his tenure (1720–1740).
